0022600222.text: The Bucks host the Lakers at 1-9, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the East, while Los Angeles arrives 10-2 on a six-game winning streak and leads the West. Milwaukee is 1-5 at home and Los Angeles is 5-1 on the road, and Tyler Herro is out with a knee bruise after averaging 21.4 points in 30.7 minutes per game this season, while Lakers guard Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision. The teams split the 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Bucks winning the most recent meeting 105-101 in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026, and no games have been played yet between them this season.
